items.title: Extract ECC advisor trial transcript and notes from a completed run
items.description: I run the ECC database advisor trial and end up with a run directory that I need to turn into a reviewable record. Extract the advisor's delivered notes from the run, separate the ones that were delivered from the ones that were suppressed, errored, or never matched a call, and refuse the run when it is incomplete, exits non-zero, or is ambiguous. A completed run with no advise call is valid and yields zero findings. The command must write nothing to the output path when it refuses a run, and its exit code must reflect that refusal.
acceptance_criteria: delivered notes are separated from suppressed, errored, and unmatched calls
an exit-code, incomplete, or ambiguous run is refused without writing to the output path
the command exits 1 on a refused run and 0 on a completed one
